hook: Songe trains your local model while your agent is idle.
what_happened: Songe records what happens after your local model's actions, then trains a better version on your own computer when your agent is idle.
why_it_matters: It personalizes your model on your own machine; nothing leaves it unless you turn on the optional cloud learning.
the_catch: Training only works on machines with a GPU; CPU‑only setups only record.
caption: Songe lets your local language model learn from your own usage, training privately on idle compute. Local or cloud training?
alt_text: The carousel explains that Songe watches a local language model during idle time, records usage, and trains a better version on the same machine, all privately.
picked_because: They would miss a free method to turn unused CPU/GPU cycles into a private, cost‑free training engine for their own models.

es.hook: Songe entrena tu modelo local mientras tu agente está inactivo.
es.what_happened: Songe registra lo que ocurre después de las acciones de tu modelo local. Cuando tu agente está inactivo, entrena una versión mejorada en tu propia computadora.
es.why_it_matters: Personaliza tu modelo en tu propia máquina; nada sale de ella a menos que actives el aprendizaje opcional en la nube.
es.the_catch: El entrenamiento solo funciona en máquinas con GPU; los equipos que solo disponen de CPU únicamente pueden registrar.
